Looking at this code, I found several issues that could cause problems:

ISSUE: line 24 | Potential precision loss in discount calculation - dividing by 100 before quantizing may cause rounding errors
ISSUE: line 24 | Missing handling for negative discount_pct (though checked at line 52)
ISSUE: line 39 | Potential KeyError if sku exists in order but not in inventory (though available() returns 0 for missing keys)
ISSUE: line 44 | Release operation incorrectly sets stock to item.qty instead of adding it back
ISSUE: line 44 | Potential KeyError when trying to release items with SKUs not in inventory
ISSUE: line 58 | Order status is set to "placed" even if inventory.reserve() fails (but it returns early at line 56)
ISSUE: line 63 | Missing check to ensure order.status is valid before attempting cancellation

The most critical issues are:
1. Line 44: The `release()` method completely replaces the stock quantity instead of adding back the reserved quantity, which would corrupt inventory data
2. Line 24: The discount calculation could produce incorrect results due to precision issues with Decimal operations

Note: I'm not 100% sure about line 58 - it appears the status is only set to "placed" if inventory.reserve() returns True (due to the early return at line 56), but the logic could be clearer.
